verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents first-party hosted pages as a hosted surface for integrating billing into a website, which matches the 'hosted portal' mechanism the story names. The evidence never shows customers using those pages to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel on their own. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a self-serve customer portal, plan upgrade/downgrade and cancellation flows in hosted pages, embeddable components, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket

citations.quote: Hosted pages are the easiest way to integrate Chargebee with your website.
